Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to extract the specific C-suite members from the monday.com "Corporate Governance - Management Team" page. While the Orchestrator correctly identified the page and instructed WebSurfer to "list the names and positions," WebSurfer's response only provided a generic summary of the page's structure (Header, Main Content, Profiles) without actually listing the names (Roy Mann, Eran Zinman, Eliran Glazer, Shiran Nawi) and their positions as requested. This failure to extract the critical data in the first step forced the entire subsequent process to rely on educated guesses and inefficient search loops to find information that was already available on the page.
